Safe 0x7c4c7ac39f3db79b10400b17a2f67dd6a4e9fec3 on Ethereum Mainnet (chain 1), nonce 4, under Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre. Disputed rules: R-4.5 and R-4.4. The transaction delegate calls MultiSendCallOnly 1.3.0, whose second call is approve(0x8bfda592080c2ce64512e67866dbcbbe72e26059, 2^256-1) on WETH9 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 (identified from Sourcify's verified record, matching the account's code at block 26280091). Under § 2.5 and R-4.5, a max uint256 ERC-20 approval is always functionally unlimited and fails immediately, so the transaction is insecure (§ 3.7). R-4.4 is not reached. Novel fact pattern; no precedent applied.
